title: DocTalk: Enhancing Medical Knowledge Retrieval via Fine-tuned Large Language Models with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Robust Clinical Decision Support
abstract: arXiv:2610.34871v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Objective: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) in healthcare has opened new possibilities for AI-assisted clinical decision-making; however, safe and effective deployment remains challenging because of hallucination and domain misalignment. This study introduces DocTalk, a doctor-assistive question-answering (QA) system designed to generate concise, chart-grounded responses from de-identified discharge summaries. Methods: We developed a high-fidelity data generation pipeline that produces 500 clinically relevant QA pairs through sentence-level decomposition, chain-of-thought-guided question formulation, and expert review. Six open-source LLMs, including three general-purpose and three biomedical models, were evaluated before and after parameter-efficient instruction tuning using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). translated_title: DocTalk：通过基于思维链推理的微调大语言模型增强医学知识检索，实现稳健的临床决策支持
translated_abstract: 目标：大语言模型（LLMs）在医疗健康领域的快速发展为AI辅助临床决策开辟了新的可能性；然而，由于幻觉和领域不对齐问题，其安全有效的部署仍然充满挑战。本研究介绍了DocTalk，一个医生辅助问答（QA）系统，旨在从去标识化的出院小结中生成简洁、基于病历的回复。方法：我们开发了一个高保真数据生成流水线，通过句子级分解、思维链引导的问题构建和专家审查，生成了500个临床相关的问答对。我们评估了六个开源大语言模型（包括三个通用模型和三个生物医学模型）在使用低秩适应（LoRA）进行参数高效指令微调前后的表现。该框架集成了提示工程、上下文学习和医学对齐评估，以支持事实性（摘要不完整）……
tldr: DocTalk是一个基于思维链推理的医生辅助问答系统，通过构建包含500个临床问答对的高保真数据流水线，并利用LoRA对六个开源大语言模型进行参数高效指令微调，实现了从出院小结中生成准确、基于病历的临床决策支持回复。
en_tdlr: DocTalk is a doctor-assistive QA system that generates 500 clinically relevant QA pairs through a chain-of-thought-guided data pipeline and applies parameter-efficient LoRA fine-tuning to six open-source LLMs, enabling accurate, chart-grounded clinical decision support from de-identified discharge summaries.
